100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101802.name: 觉悟

101804.name: 好机会！小渡！

101805.name: 正义必胜
101805.SpecificEffects: 场上敌机数量大于等于我方时，所有友军遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>5%</color>，反之，伤害提升<color=#F74848>5%</color>

101806.name: 辉龙·龙雷拳
101806.describe:

101807.name: 勇气

101808.name: 辉龙必杀·凤龙剑

同时装备刀剑和手盾才可使用

101836.name: 勇者4
